title: 4. Relation integrity: what is done and what is missing

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: The relation layer is typed and governed; the constraints a graph needs (acyclicity, cardinality, endpoint types) are not.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: Done: installable relation types (RFC-005), relation rows in rendering (RFC-027), relational lifecycle states (RFC-022), the relation principles R1 to R11 (srs#171, with eight open defects in srs#287), and decision 0750c62f: membership is declared and meaning lives in relations. Missing: declared structural constraints (unit cf9f5816). Measured: the spec's concept graph is not a DAG, with three two-cycles among 44 concepts (srs-context finding e1d026a5).

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Must integrity constraints come before a graph surface?
